title: AppsFlyer Pricing 2026: Plans, Tiers & Costs | metacto

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, AppsFlyer's Zero plan is free for apps with under 12,000 lifetime non-organic installs.
facts.quote: a **Free “Zero” plan** for apps with under 12,000 lifetime non-organic installs

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, AppsFlyer's Growth plan costs $0.07 per conversion after the 12,000-conversion Welcome Package.
facts.quote: **$0.07 per conversion** after your Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions.

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, as of February 2026, connected TV, PC, and console platform installs are also charged at the $0.07 Growth rate.
facts.quote: As of February 2026, connected TV, PC, and console platform installs are also charged at the $0.07 rate.

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, the Zero plan's Welcome Package includes 12,000 free conversions to use within the first 12 months.
facts.quote: 12,000 free conversions to use within your first 12 months

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, the Zero plan includes a 30-day trial of premium add-ons.
facts.quote: plus a 30-day trial of premium add-ons

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, Growth plan annual cost at 50K monthly conversions is about $42,000 per year.
facts.quote: 50K monthly conversions: ~$42,000/year

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, Growth plan annual cost at 100K monthly conversions is about $84,000 per year.
facts.quote: 100K monthly conversions: ~$84,000/year

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, Growth plan annual cost at 200K monthly conversions is about $168,000 per year.
facts.quote: 200K monthly conversions: ~$168,000/year

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, Enterprise plan pricing is typically $0.03-$0.05 per conversion, a 29-57% discount from Growth.
facts.quote: **$0.03-$0.05 per conversion** (29-57% discount from Growth)

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, the Enterprise plan requires a 12-month minimum contract, with 24 months being optimal for best rates.
facts.quote: Requires 12-month minimum contract (24-month optimal for best rates).

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, Enterprise contracts can expect 5-15% annual renewal escalation, negotiable with longer commitments.
facts.quote: Expect 5-15% annual renewal escalation (negotiable with longer commitments).

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, Enterprise overage rates can be 2-3x the contracted rate.
facts.quote: Overage rates can be 2-3x the contracted rate.

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, at 100K monthly conversions the Enterprise plan costs approximately $48,000-$60,000 annually.
facts.quote: expect approximately $48,000-$60,000 annually (vs. $84,000 on Growth).

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, Growth plan's Raw Data API is limited to 1M rows, and Data Locker requires the Enterprise plan.
facts.quote: Raw Data API with 1M row limit (Data Locker requires Enterprise).

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, custom dashboards as a Growth-plan premium add-on cost $5,000-$30,000 per year.
facts.quote: custom dashboards ($5,000-$30,000/year)

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, the advanced fraud suite premium add-on costs $10,000-$50,000+ per year.
facts.quote: advanced fraud suite ($10,000-$50,000+/year)

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, setting up Data Locker cloud integration typically requires $5,000-$25,000+ in additional engineering or consulting costs.
facts.quote: typically requires $5,000-$25,000+ in additional engineering or consulting costs

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, the Enterprise plan includes a dedicated Customer Success Manager with a 2-hour SLA response time.
facts.quote: Dedicated Customer Success Manager with 2-hour SLA response time.

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, AppsFlyer's pricing is primarily based on the number of non-organic app installs (conversions) tracked per month.
facts.quote: AppsFlyer’s pricing is primarily based on the number of non-organic app installs (conversions) you track per month.

facts.fact: According to metacto's guide, the Enterprise plan is positioned for large-scale advertisers with 1M+ conversions.
facts.quote: Large-Scale Advertisers (1M+ conversions)

facts.fact: The metacto guide states it was updated in May 2026 to reflect AppsFlyer's current pricing structure.
facts.quote: **Updated May 2026:** This guide reflects AppsFlyer’s current pricing structure

facts.fact: Metacto estimates the annual cost of the Custom Dashboards add-on for the AppsFlyer Growth tier at $5,000 to $30,000.
facts.quote: | Custom Dashboards | $5,000 - $30,000 |

facts.fact: Metacto estimates the annual cost of the Protect360 Advanced Fraud add-on for the AppsFlyer Growth tier at $10,000 to $50,000 or more.
facts.quote: | Protect360 Advanced Fraud | $10,000 - $50,000+ |

facts.fact: Metacto states that the Data Locker add-on requires the Enterprise tier.
facts.quote: | Data Locker | Enterprise tier required |

facts.fact: Metacto estimates basic AppsFlyer SDK deployment at $9,600 to $21,600.
facts.quote: | Basic SDK Deployment | $9,600 - $21,600 |

facts.fact: Metacto estimates multi-platform AppsFlyer implementation at $28,800 to $57,600.
facts.quote: | Multi-platform Implementation | $28,800 - $57,600 |

facts.fact: Metacto estimates privacy compliance configuration for AppsFlyer at 20 to 40 hours of engineering time.
facts.quote: | Privacy Compliance Configuration | 20-40 hours engineering time |

facts.fact: Metacto estimates Data Locker cloud integration setup at $5,000 to $25,000 or more.
facts.quote: | Data Locker Cloud Integration | $5,000 - $25,000+ |

facts.fact: Metacto estimates ongoing AppsFlyer maintenance at 5 to 10 hours per month.
facts.quote: | Ongoing Maintenance | 5-10 hours monthly |

facts.fact: Metacto's example estimates Year 1 total cost of the AppsFlyer Growth plan (base only, including implementation) at about $94,000 to $106,000 for a company tracking 100K monthly conversions.
Metacto's example estimates Year 1 total cost of the Growth plan with premium add-ons at about $120,000 to $150,000 for 100K monthly conversions.
facts.quote: | Growth + premium add-ons | ~$120,000 - $150,000 |

facts.fact: Metacto's example estimates Year 1 total cost of a negotiated Enterprise plan at about $70,000 to $90,000 for 100K monthly conversions.
facts.quote: | Enterprise (negotiated) | ~$70,000 - $90,000 |

facts.fact: According to the page, organic installs are free under AppsFlyer, while non-organic installs, re-engagement events, and (as of February 2026) CTV/PC/console installs count as conversions.
facts.quote: A “conversion” includes non-organic installs, re-engagement events, and (as of February 2026) CTV/PC/console installs at the same rate. Organic installs are free.

facts.fact: Metacto states that AppsFlyer Enterprise renewals typically include 5-15% price increases, though these are negotiable with longer commitments.
facts.quote: Enterprise renewals typically include 5-15% price increases, though these are negotiable with longer commitments.

facts.fact: Metacto states that Enterprise customers exceeding contracted volumes may face 2-3x the base rate.
facts.quote: Enterprise customers exceeding contracted volumes may face 2-3x the base rate.

facts.fact: Metacto states that for full SKAN 4.0 data on iOS, the AppsFlyer SDK should be version 6.10 or later.
facts.quote: For iOS, ensure you’re on SDK v6.10+ to receive full SKAN 4.0 data.

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer FAQ says the Zero plan is free and limited to 12,000 lifetime installs.
facts.quote: The 'Zero' plan is free (limited to 12,000 lifetime installs).

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer FAQ says the Growth plan costs $0.07 per conversion after the free Welcome Package.
facts.quote: The 'Growth' plan costs $0.07 per conversion after your free Welcome Package.

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer FAQ says Enterprise negotiated rates are $0.03-$0.05 per conversion with annual contracts.
facts.quote: The 'Enterprise' plan offers negotiated rates of $0.03-$0.05 per conversion with annual contracts.

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer FAQ says the Zero plan includes a Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions for the first year.
facts.quote: a Welcome Package of 12,000 free conversions for your first year.

facts.fact: Metacto's FAQ estimates AppsFlyer Growth plan cost at approximately $84,000 annually at 100K monthly conversions.
facts.quote: At 100K monthly conversions, expect approximately $84,000 annually.

facts.fact: The AppsFlyer Growth plan includes Raw Data API access with a 1M row limit, according to the FAQ.
facts.quote: Raw Data API access (1M row limit)

facts.fact: Metacto suggests considering the AppsFlyer Enterprise plan when approaching 1M annual conversions.
facts.quote: Consider Enterprise when approaching 1M annual conversions.

facts.fact: The FAQ states AppsFlyer Data Locker is only available on Enterprise plans and delivers raw event-level data to Amazon S3 or Google Cloud Storage.
facts.quote: It's only available on Enterprise plans and is included in the contract rather than priced separately.
